text: 金十数据8月2日讯，中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议指出，重点领域金融风险持续化解。金融支持融资平台债务风险化解取得显著成效。金融市场运行态势良好。从宏观审慎角度监测、评估债市运行，加强债券市场监管执法。发挥两项支持资本市场货币政策工具的作用，稳定和增强
text_en: Jin Shi Data, Aug 2 – The People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference. The meeting noted that financial risks in key areas continued to be resolved. Significant progress was made in financial support for resolving financing platform debt risks. Financial market operations were sound. Bond market conditions are monitored and evaluated from a macroprudential perspective, with strengthened bond market regulation and enforcement.
